title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Prohibition on Disclosure of Confidential Information)
A member or former member shall not disclose confidential information learned in the course of performing duties, including matters examined by the Recommendation Committee.
